title: PGSimCity - How PostgreSQL Works
author: jonbaer
relevanceReason: PGSimCity 是一个关于 PostgreSQL 内部机制的可视化教育项目，属于开源数据库技术范畴，与开发工具和编程高度相关。
summaryRaw: PGSimCity is an independent, non-commercial educational visualization of PostgreSQL internals. It is not affiliated with, sponsored, endorsed, or approved by Electronic Arts Inc. SimCity is a trademark of Electronic Arts Inc. A working model of the PostgreSQL engine loading the city code… Early, unreviewed prototype. It almost certainly contains inaccuracies in both the model and explanations. Found one? Open an issue or send a pull request.
summaryZh: PGSimCity 是一个独立、非商业的教育可视化项目，旨在展示 PostgreSQL 的内部工作原理。
该项目以类似 SimCity 的方式模拟 PostgreSQL 引擎加载城市代码的过程，帮助开发者直观理解数据库内部机制。
目前为早期未审核原型，可能存在模型和解释上的不准确之处，欢迎社区贡献改进。
highlightsZh: 通过可视化方式帮助开发者深入理解 PostgreSQL 的内部架构。
项目独立且非商业，专注于教育目的，与 Electronic Arts 无关联。
作为开源项目，鼓励社区参与发现问题并提交改进建议。
为数据库学习和教学提供了一种创新且直观的辅助工具。

comments.author: layoric
comments.textRawHtml:
I love what is trying to be done here. Some feedback to improve would be to cut out a lot of the noise with the "Take tour". There are too many boxes and things changing on the screen to get a sense of what is happening. Also make it interactive rather than automatically switch onto the next subject. Being a passive observer to so much information trying to be conveyed is very confusing.

I really do like these kinds of approaches to showing the inner workings of different kinds of tech, so think this is on the good path to being a very useful tool, but needs some focus rather than more data/graphs/info boxes.
comments.textZhHtml:
我喜欢这里所做的事情。一些需要改进的反馈是通过“Taketour”消除大量噪音。屏幕上有太多的方框和变化的东西，无法了解正在发生的事情。还要使其具有交互性，而不是自动切换到下一个主题。作为一个被动的观察者，试图传达如此多的信息是非常令人困惑的。

我真的很喜欢这种展示不同技术内部运作方式的方法，所以我认为这是成为一个非常有用的工具的良好途径，但需要一些关注，而不是更多的数据/图表/信息框。

children.author: samokhvalov
children.textRawHtml:
it was silly, quick check out of curiosity what Opus 5 can do – and the first thing I saw was so impressive that it made me spend hours during weekend polishing it

here it is from history, without edits

> you're a veteran Postgres hacker and expert. I want 3D visualization of how Postgres works, for browser -- all its major components, presented as a 3d model, complex, with all parts zoomable, and animated, with controls -- checkpointer, bgwriter, autovacuum, walwriter, backends, walsender, etc etc etc. Imagine we need to build a 3d model of whole city. That's same level. We need this so engineers who are non-DB-experts would easily understand how it works. Design must be cool, modern, super cool, running all in browser, with controls, with camera position flying with arrow keys and mouse, zoomable, etc. Think deep how to implement it, which modern cool tech to use, and use ultracode to implement in a new directory (we'll commit it later). OK to use the most cool and most modern stuff. Think deep choose tools wisely and let's build an awesome in-browser 3d model of Postgres engine

(later I came with lots of materials about internals and behavior and we started to polish / improve)
children.textZhHtml:
一开始只是心血来潮，出于好奇随便看看 Opus 5 能做什么——结果第一眼看到的东西就太惊艳了，让我整个周末都花了好几个小时去打磨它

这是从历史记录里直接拿出来的，没做过修改

> 你是一位资深的 Postgres 黑客和专家。我想要一个在浏览器里运行的 Postgres 工作原理 3D 可视化模型——包含所有主要组件，呈现为一个复杂的 3D 模型，所有部分都可缩放、带动画、带控制——包括 checkpointer、bgwriter、autovacuum、walwriter、backends、walsender 等等等等。想象一下我们需要建一个整个城市的 3D 模型。就是这种级别的复杂度。我们需要这个来让非数据库专家的工程师们也能轻松理解它的工作原理。设计必须酷炫、现代、超级酷炫，完全在浏览器中运行，带控制，能用方向键和鼠标控制相机视角飞行，可缩放等等。深入思考如何实现，使用哪些现代酷炫的技术，并用 ultracode 在一个新目录中实现（我们稍后再提交）。可以使用最酷、最现代的东西。深入思考，明智地选择工具，让我们一起构建一个超赞的浏览器内 Postgres 引擎 3D 模型

（后来我又找了很多关于内部机制和行为的资料，然后我们开始打磨/改进）

children.author: npl
children.textRawHtml: I frequently have asked Claude to explain different software architecture things that I don’t know because I’m not formally technically trained - like “explain Django as though it’s a city with different parts having different roles”. I’m a visual learner so this helps a lot and gives me ideas for how to have similar visualizing for other stuff at various levels of abstraction.
children.textZhHtml: 我经常让 Claude 给我解释一些我不懂的不同软件架构知识，因为我没有受过正规的技术训练——比如“把 Django 解释成一座城市，不同部分扮演不同角色”。我是视觉型学习者，所以这对我帮助很大，也给了我灵感，让我知道如何在不同抽象层级上对其他事物进行类似的可视化。

children.author: andyfilms1
children.textRawHtml: This is good general advice. If your software needs a "tour," that's a good indicator you should work on your UX instead. If you're just excited to tell the user about a new feature, they'll discover it when they need it.
children.textZhHtml: 这是很好的一般性建议。如果您的软件需要“游览”，那么这是一个很好的指示，您应该在用户体验上工作。如果您只是很高兴向用户介绍一项新功能，他们会在需要时发现它。

comments.author: narmiouh
comments.textRawHtml:
I imagined as soon I saw the initial visual that I would somehow be able to enter a query and it would walk me through the flow through the entire system starting from input parsing to all the way to delivering output and perhaps along the way understand some of the autonomous processes that happen in parallel that aren't query specific but run constantly.

What others are saying - fantastic attempt, but don't know where to start or where to end.
comments.textZhHtml:
我想象，当我看到最初的视觉效果时，我能够以某种方式输入查询，它会引导我完成整个系统的流程，从输入解析开始一直到交付输出，也许一路上理解一些并行发生的自治进程，这些进程不是特定于查询的，而是不断运行。

其他人所说的 - 很棒的尝试，但不知道从哪里开始或从哪里结束。
